english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is seriously bad or intense.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when the harmful or incapacitating effect is described generally.
Choose this for an extreme or severe degree, especially serious consequences or a heavy price.
Use this for a serious problem or situation when the emphasis is on severity or bad consequences.
Use 嚴重 when real means serious or grave, as in a real problem.
Use this when “massive” means severe or seriously affecting the body, rather than physically large.
Use this for an illness, injury, risk, or other situation that is major because it is serious or life-threatening.
Use this for a dire or distressing situation rather than bodily pain.
